newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-WMC sees petroleum assets sold in 97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-WMC sees petroleum assets sold in 97.

text.p: Base metals and gold miner WMC Ltd said on Wednesday it was confident that its remaining petroleum assets would be sold before June 30 this year and at a premium to book value.
"There has been a lot of competition for the assets and we will undoubtedly exceed book value for them," WMC managing director Hugh Morgan told a news conference.
Morgan said the remaining assets were Australia and New Zealand based, but declined to give their book value.
Morgan said the book value of WMC's total petroleum portfolio was A$320 million, including those already sold.
